title: Semi-Supervised Learning-Based Genetic Biomarkers Dataset for Multiple-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.17100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Liver cancer is a complex disease responsible for a high number of deaths across the globe each year, making automated solutions for liver cancer classification urgent. The most common form of liver cancer is hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), accounting for over 90% of liver cancer cases. There is a distinct lack of publicly available HCC datasets utilizing genomic data, which is necessary for training artificial intelligence (AI) models for automated HCC classification. This study proposes constructing a multi-stage HCC dataset using XGBoost and Semi-Supervised learning on three separate datasets of genomic biomarkers, utilizing their existing labels in the Semi-Supervised learning process to label the proposed dataset. The proposed dataset consists of 770 patient samples in total, categorized into five classes that represent normal tissue alongside different stages of HCC. translated_title: 基于半监督学习的多阶段肝细胞癌预测基因生物标志物数据集
translated_abstract: 肝癌是一种复杂的疾病，每年在全球造成大量死亡，因此迫切需要肝癌分类的自动化解决方案。最常见的肝癌形式是肝细胞癌（HCC），占肝癌病例的90%以上。目前极为缺乏利用基因组数据的公开HCC数据集，而这类数据集对于训练用于自动化HCC分类的人工智能（AI）模型是必不可少的。本研究提出利用XGBoost和半监督学习方法，在三个独立的基因组生物标志物数据集上构建一个多阶段HCC数据集，并在半监督学习过程中利用其现有标签为所构建的数据集进行标注。所提出的数据集共包含770个患者样本，划分为五个类别，分别代表正常组织以及不同阶段的HCC。数据集中的每个样本由11,150个不同的基因表达组成。
tldr: 本研究利用XGBoost和半监督学习，在三个基因组生物标志物数据集基础上构建了一个包含770个患者样本、涵盖正常组织及各阶段肝细胞癌的五分类基因表达数据集，填补了公开HCC基因组数据集的空白。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a five-class gene expression dataset of 770 patient samples covering normal tissue and multiple stages of hepatocellular carcinoma using XGBoost and semi-supervised learning on three genomic biomarker datasets, addressing the scarcity of publicly available HCC genomic datasets.
